data.gender_notes: Mohibun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-b-b' which means 'to love'. In Islamic context, Mohibun refers to someone who is loved by Allah and strives to please Him. The name Mohibun carries the meaning “Beloved, Lover” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mohibun usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved, lover and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mohibun total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
